summary.request: Buyers set a Cost Reason on purchase invoice lines that are charged to a project. Project managers need to see the Cost Reason on project ledger entries for those purchases, including subcontractor hours we buy from vendors.
summary.business-process: Carry a custom Cost Reason from project-linked purchase lines through purchase posting and project usage posting (Purch.-Post, Job Post-Line, Job Transfer Line, Job Jnl.-Post Line) to the project ledger entries.

Job Post-Line builds a separate project journal line for each project-linked item or G/L account purchase line; G/L account lines are posted later from a temporary copy of this line, so the value must be on it.

objects.purpose: Single-purpose subscriber codeunit holding the two Job Transfer Line subscribers: purchase line to project journal line, and project journal line to project ledger entry. One pair covers item and G/L account lines, including subcontractor hours bought as G/L account or item lines.

Lets buyers enter Cost Reason on purchase invoice lines. Other purchase line pages (order, credit memo) are q-entry-pages. The page field is bound to the table field and inherits its ToolTip from BC24 (runtime 13.0); on earlier runtimes declare the ToolTip on the page control.
Shows Cost Reason to project managers on the project ledger entries list (non-editable). Bound field inherits the table field ToolTip from BC24 (runtime 13.0).

data-flow.note: Entered on project-linked purchase invoice lines through the Purch. Invoice Subform page extension.
Standard InitFromPurchLine TransferFields; no subscriber needed.
Standard InitFromPurchLine TransferFields; stage chosen by the mirroring article, see q-mirror-targets.
Standard InitFromPurchLine TransferFields; stage chosen by the mirroring article, see q-mirror-targets.
Standard InitFromPurchLine TransferFields; stage chosen by the mirroring article, see q-mirror-targets.
ArchiveManagement copies lines with TransferFields; stage chosen by the mirroring article, see q-mirror-targets.

Job Post-Line.PostJobOnPurchaseLine calls Job Transfer Line.FromPurchaseLineToJnlLine for Item and G/L Account lines only; copy in OnAfterFromPurchaseLineToJnlLine. Item lines post at once (Job Posting Only); G/L account lines are held in a temporary table and posted by PostJobPurchaseLines after the G/L entries exist, carrying the value with them.
Job Jnl.-Post Line.CreateJobLedgEntry calls Job Transfer Line.FromJnlLineToLedgEntry for every source; copy in OnAfterFromJnlLineToLedgEntry while the entry is built, never Modify after insert.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy PurchLine."Cost Reason" to JobJnlLine."Cost Reason" for project-linked Item and G/L Account purchase lines, so the value is set before the deferred G/L account project lines are posted.
guards: Assign the field only; the journal line is still being built, so do not call Modify.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy JobJournalLine."Cost Reason" to JobLedgerEntry."Cost Reason" while the entry is built in CreateJobLedgEntry; one subscriber covers every source of project journal lines.
guards: Assign before insert; never subscribe to OnAfterJobLedgEntryInsert and Modify the inserted entry.

lifecycle.step: Set DataClassification = CustomerContent explicitly on Cost Reason in every table extension (a tableextension has no table-level classification to inherit); never leave it ToBeClassified or SystemMetadata.

No upgrade code: the field is new, has no InitValue, and blank is a valid state. Project ledger entries and posted lines created before installation stay blank unless back-fill is requested (q-history-backfill).
No permission set: the feature adds only table extensions, a subscriber codeunit and page extensions, and no new table.

tests.given: A vendor, an item, a project with a project task (created with the test Library codeunits), and a purchase invoice with an Item line charged to the project task with a Cost Reason.
tests.then: The Purch. Inv. Line and the project usage Job Ledger Entry for that document carry the same Cost Reason.

tests.given: A purchase invoice with a G/L Account line charged to a project task, with a Cost Reason (fixtures from library codeunits).
tests.then: The Job Ledger Entry posted after the G/L entries (deferred PostJobPurchaseLines path) carries the Cost Reason.

tests.given: Subcontractor hours bought from a vendor as a purchase invoice line of the agreed supported type (G/L Account or Item, per q-subcontractor-hours) charged to a project task, with a Cost Reason and a quantity of hours.
tests.then: A Job Ledger Entry exists for the hours with the Cost Reason.

tests.given: A purchase order with a project-linked Item line with a Cost Reason.
tests.when: The order is posted as receive only.
tests.then: The Purch. Rcpt. Line carries the Cost Reason.

tests.given: A purchase credit memo with a project-linked Item line with a Cost Reason.
tests.then: The Purch. Cr. Memo Line and the resulting Job Ledger Entry carry the Cost Reason.

tests.given: A purchase return order with an Item line with a Cost Reason.
tests.when: The return order is posted as ship only.
tests.then: The Return Shipment Line carries the Cost Reason.

tests.given: A purchase order with a line with a Cost Reason.
tests.when: The document is archived through ArchiveManagement.
tests.then: The Purchase Line Archive row carries the Cost Reason.

knowledge.used-for: Map that selected the Purchase and Projects row groups and the cross-cutting rows (mirrored definitions, copy document, checks before posting, upgrade back-fill, privacy, tests).
constraints: Plan one row group per process the request touches and open every linked article for the stages chosen.
Whether a field should reach a stage the request does not name is a question for the requester; raise one question per group of stages.
Do not fill other records with subscribers that find and modify them after posting.

knowledge.used-for: Core path Purchase Line -> Job Journal Line -> Job Ledger Entry, and the design of subcontractor hours as supported line types.
constraints: Add the field to Job Journal Line and Job Ledger Entry; copy it in OnAfterFromPurchaseLineToJnlLine, then in OnAfterFromJnlLineToLedgEntry.
Only Item and G/L Account purchase lines with a project post project usage; Resource purchase lines post only a resource ledger entry and no project usage.
When project cost comes from a purchase, design it as an item or G/L account line with the project; post resource time through a project journal resource line.
Matching field numbers between Purchase Line and Job Ledger Entry do not copy the value.

knowledge.used-for: Purchase line to project journal line hop, and the list of other Job Transfer Line sources raised as an open question.
constraints: Decide which sources must carry the value and subscribe to the matching Job Transfer Line events.
A field that exists only on the project journal is empty for usage posted from a purchase invoice and every other generated line.

knowledge.used-for: Project journal line to project ledger entry hop.
constraints: Subscribe to OnAfterFromJnlLineToLedgEntry on Job Transfer Line to copy the value while the entry is built; one subscriber covers every source.
Do not rely on matching field numbers, and do not Modify the entry in OnAfterJobLedgEntryInsert.

knowledge.used-for: Mirroring the line field on posted purchase lines and the line archive.
constraints: Give the field the same number, name, type and length on Purchase Line and every target: Purch. Rcpt. Line, Purch. Inv. Line, Purch. Cr. Memo Line, Return Shipment Line and Purchase Line Archive, unless the plan states a document type never needs it.
No subscriber is needed for these stages; keep the mirrored fields non-editable on posted tables.
Do not patch posted records with Modify in a subscriber.

knowledge.used-for: Field definitions of the mirrored Cost Reason fields.
constraints: Define the mirrored field with exactly the same field number, data type and length on every table in the TransferFields cascade.

knowledge.used-for: Sizing Cost Reason if it gets a TableRelation (q-cost-reason-source).
constraints: For an unconditional relation, give the field the same type and exact length as the related field; read the related field's declared length rather than assuming Code[10] or Code[20].

knowledge.used-for: Data classification of every Cost Reason field.
constraints: Every Normal field added by a tableextension must set its own DataClassification matching the data it stores; never leave ToBeClassified or use SystemMetadata for customer data.

knowledge.used-for: ToolTip placement for the page extension fields; applies from BC24 (runtime 13.0).
constraints: On runtime 13.0 or later a bound page field inherits the table field's ToolTip; do not add a duplicate page-level ToolTip.
On earlier runtimes, or with no inheritable ToolTip, the page control must declare one.

knowledge.used-for: No upgrade code for the new field.
constraints: A schema element that is new in an unreleased version needs no upgrade or migration path.

knowledge.used-for: Confirms existing rows stay blank; no InitValue is used, so no back-fill is required by the field definition.
constraints: InitValue does not back-fill existing rows; if existing rows must carry a value, ship upgrade code guarded by an upgrade tag.
Build vendors, items, G/L accounts and documents with the test Library codeunits, parents first, validating foreign-key fields.
Generate incidental fixture values with library codeunits; keep scenario-defining values such as quantities and the Cost Reason explicit; do not rely on pre-existing records.

open-questions.question: What is a Cost Reason: a free code, a relation to the standard Reason Code table, or a new Cost Reason table maintained by users? This sets the field's type, length and TableRelation on every table, and a new table would need its own page, permissions and setup.

How are subcontractor hours bought today? Purchase lines of type Resource with a project post only a resource ledger entry and no project usage, so they never reach the project ledger. Should buyers buy subcontractor hours as G/L Account (or Item) lines charged to the project, or post them through a project journal resource line, where the Cost Reason would be entered on the project journal? Should Cost Reason also reach Resource Ledger Entries?
The design mirrors Cost Reason on posted receipt, invoice, credit memo and return shipment lines and on the purchase line archive. Should any of these document types be excluded?

Should Cost Reason also be carried on project ledger entries that do not come from purchases: manual project journal lines, project planning lines, planning lines invoiced through sales, and general journal lines with a project?
Should buyers also enter Cost Reason on purchase order and purchase credit memo lines, and should it be shown on posted purchase document line pages?
Is Cost Reason mandatory on project-linked purchase lines before posting? If so, the check belongs in OnAfterCheckPurchDoc so it also stops the posting preview.
Must Cost Reason survive Copy Document (including the recalculate-lines path, which drops custom line fields) and corrective credit memos?
Do existing project ledger entries and posted purchase lines need a Cost Reason back-filled, and from what source?
